verdict.rationale: Anrok's AI-Atlas product explicitly lets users 'ask it anything about your sales tax and get an answer with reasoning shown,' which is a natural-language interface, and Headless Tax mentions handing tax jobs 'to your agents.' However, these are marketing blurbs with no documented command syntax, examples of NL commands, or evidence of a chat/agent interface actually executing operations. missing for 10: hands-on examples of NL commands driving actions, documentation of the AI-Atlas interface/API, independent corroboration of agentic operation beyond a product page.
